content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, and similar appeals produced no payments; resubmission would not cure the authorization defect. The denial does not establish a contractual patient share despite the remaining deductible, so the balance is not properly billable to the patient.","action":"write_off"}
